name: email-warmer-keep-signoff
prompt:
Make this email warmer in tone. Keep the meeting time and keep the sign-off lines exactly as they are. Return only the email.

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the review notes. I have folded in the two changes you asked for and re-ran the numbers; the revised deck is attached. Can we meet Thursday at 2pm to walk through the open questions before the board call?

Best regards,
Nazeer

expected.truth: Thursday at 2pm must survive; the sign-off 'Best regards,' followed by 'Nazeer' must survive exactly; the attached deck and the two folded-in changes remain.

shape: Returns the email alone; no assistant preamble or closer around it
The requested sign-off is not removed as a 'closer'
Tone is warmer without adding new commitments
